name: comparator
description: The analog comparator times an RC network: D8 charges 1 uF on AIN0 through 10 kOhm against 2.5 V on AIN1. R * C * ln 2 with the pin's 25 Ohm is 6949 us; the sketch measures 6960 us rising and 6956 us falling with micros() (4 us steps, plus digitalWrite and the interrupt's entry). ACO reads 0 discharged and 1 charged; the interrupt fires once per crossing, on the edge ACIS chooses.
